# Process

The processes of the host. `osapi behavior get --name process` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Description | List the processes of the host                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Lists each process with its user, state, CPU and memory, its command line and when it started, through gohai: from /proc on Linux and from ps on macOS. A process that stops while the list is read is not in it. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/process                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Permission  | process:read                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Command     | [osapi client node process list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/process/list.md)                                                                                                                                  |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (9)

| FIELD       | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                            |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| pid         | integer | The process ID                                         |
| name        | string  | The name of the process                                |
| user        | string  | The user that runs it                                  |
| state       | string  | Its state, such as running or sleep                    |
| cpu_percent | number  | Its CPU time as a percent of the time since it started |
| mem_percent | number  | Its resident memory as a percent of the host's memory  |
| mem_rss     | integer | Its resident memory in bytes                           |
| command     | string  | Its full command line                                  |
| start_time  | string  | When it started, in RFC 3339                           |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                      | INPUT  | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A Linux host that runs sleep | (none) | \[command=sleep 300, cpu_percent=5, mem_percent=1, mem_rss=2.097152e+07, name=sleep, pid=1234, start_time=2026-01-02T02:55:45Z, state=sleep, user=alice] |
| A Mac that runs sleep        | (none) | \[command=sleep 300, cpu_percent=5, mem_percent=1, mem_rss=2.097152e+07, name=sleep, pid=1234, state=sleep, user=alice]                                  |

## Method signal

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | signal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Send a signal to a process                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Detail      | Sends TERM, KILL, HUP, INT, USR1 or USR2 to one process with kill, and reports changed: true. A process that the host does not have is not found. A process ID below 1 is refused, because kill sends to a group of processes for 0 and for a negative ID. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/process/&#123;pid&#125;/signal                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Permission  | process:execute                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Command     | [osapi client node process signal](../../../usage/cli/client/node/process/signal.md)                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Input type  | SignalInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (2)

| FIELD  | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                        | DESCRIPTION                                    |
| ------ | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| pid    | integer | yes      | min 1                              | The process ID, such as 1234                   |
| signal | string  | yes      | one of TERM KILL HUP INT USR1 USR2 | The signal: TERM, KILL, HUP, INT, USR1 or USR2 |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                 |
| ------- | ------- | --------------------------- |
| pid     | integer | The process ID              |
| signal  | string  | The signal that was sent    |
| changed | boolean | Whether the signal was sent |

### Examples (1)

| EXAMPLE        | INPUT                 | OUTPUT                              |
| -------------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Stop a process | pid=1234, signal=TERM | pid=1234, signal=TERM, changed=true |
